title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: lapse of quotes, cancellation before departure and premium refund
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs quotes that lapse, the cancellation of a bound cover before the vessel departs, and the refund of premium on a cancelled cover.

## Policy clause

1. A quote that is not bound by the binding deadline, or that the customer declines, lapses without charge and moves to the cancelled state.
2. A bound cover may be cancelled on the cover holder's instruction only while the booking has not departed. After departure the risk has attached and the cover cannot be cancelled. The booking's status is read from the booking record; the booking statuses in which cancellation remains possible are requested, confirmed, equipment released, gated in, loaded and cancelled.
3. On cancellation, the product's refund share percent of the premium charged is refunded, rounded to the cent, referencing the premium charge entry it refunds.
4. The refund applies to premium already paid and to premium still due alike, because it reduces the premium owed.
5. AHL Standard Carrier Liability is never cancelled, because it is the statutory regime.
6. A premium refund may be booked only on a cover whose status is cancelled.
7. A premium charge entry is refunded at most once.

## Decision table

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Quote not bound by the binding deadline | Lapses without charge |
| Quote declined by the customer | Lapses without charge |
| Bound cover, booking in a status listed in clause 2 | May be cancelled on the holder's instruction; refund follows |
| Bound cover, booking departed | Cannot be cancelled |
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | Never cancelled |

## Hypothetical worked example

Hypothetical figures only: a premium of 1,234.57 USD was charged and the product's refund share is taken as 80 percent. The refund is 80 percent of 1,234.57, which is 987.656, rounded to the cent as 987.66 USD. The refund is the same whether the 1,234.57 USD was already paid or is still due; where it is still due, the refund reduces the premium owed.

## Points of judgement

**May a second refund be booked against the same premium charge?** No. A premium charge entry is refunded at most once.

**May a refund be booked while the cover is still active?** No. A refund is booked only on a cancelled cover.
